source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1.First, make sure you have a NFS share available and that you already know the share's IP address, path, username, and password.
2.Login bmc WebUI
3.mkdir /mnt/nfs_mount
4.mount -t nfs 192.168.0.169:/home/opt /mnt/nfs_mount
NFS — < IP to connect for NFS file system>:/<file path>/<image name>
NOTE:192.168.0.169 is the IP address of your NFS server, /home/opt is the path of the share
5. Use df -h confirm whether the mount is successful
6. Image mount using OpenBMC's Web GUI. From the remote console interface, select Media -> Activate, then select Media -> Mount virtual media.
7. In the "Mount Media File from Network" option, enter your NFS share path, for example: 192.168.0.169:/home/opt/myIMAGE.img
8. From the "Local Media Mounted" section, select your software format (probably CD/DVD), then click "Browse" to find the software file, click "Open", then click "Mount".
9.Once it's done, you can go into the mounted ISO and do things like install an operating system.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: NFS share/URL with a reachable NFS image + BMC web + OS block tools
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Mount image via NFS: mount the install image via NFS from the BMC web -> Media -> Mount Virtual Media (NFS share/URL: ${VM_SHARE:?operator must set the virtual media share or server url}/${VM_PATH:?operator must set the path on the share}/${VM_IMAGE:?operator must set the image file name}), then confirm the image appears as a boot/block device sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "lsblk 2>&1; dmesg | tail -n 15 2>&1"; state-changing mount.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the OS block-device list + BMC web mount status so the user confirms the NFS image mounted cleanly and is accessible.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: mounting an image shares it to the host and can autostart the OS; use a user-designated image URL and unmount after.

original_test_intent: Validate NFS-backed BMC virtual media, remote-console connectivity and host CD-ROM exposure; the source ambiguously also expects an auto-install program.
original_method: Use a hard-coded example NFS export, log into BMC WebUI, activate/mount the network image through remote console, verify host visibility and potentially enter an installer.
manual_activity: After correction, an engineer operates and observes BMC WebUI/remote console for a mount-only case; any boot/install action requires distinct destructive authorization.
required_inputs: Isolated SUT and protected disk inventory
BMC virtual-media SOP and expected device identity
safety_requirements: Do not use 192.168.0.169:/home/opt unless explicitly approved as the project export.
Do not boot, install, partition or write storage without explicit target-disk authorization.
Do not assume username/password semantics for NFS; apply the approved export/security model.
Deactivate media, verify device removal, preserve unexpected states and never retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: After correction, validate export/image metadata, collect read-only device/log evidence and analyze operator WebUI/console artifacts.
Do not operate the manual WebUI, start installation or set the verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve intended end state and NFS contract.
Operate WebUI/console and issue the final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its parameterized path and lsblk check do not define NFS security, remote-console acceptance, install intent, target disks or cleanup; sshpass/host-key bypass is unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do nothing until scope is corrected. For mount-only, use approved NFS export security, vendor WebUI/SOP, immutable image hash, read-only inventory and explicit deactivation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Hard-coded export example, WebUI sequence, auto-install wording and 15/5-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Split reversible NFS virtual-media mount/visibility from boot or automated installation, with separate approvals, evidence and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC with documented NFS virtual-media support.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor virtual-media and NFS security documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Eliminates implicit installer transition and adds export/disk/cleanup controls; original remains preserved.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Makes mount coverage auditable without claiming undefined installation coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Owner scope decision and exact export contract.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bootable media can change boot flow and overwrite storage.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a mount-only plan and record only that narrower scope; it cannot claim auto-install completion. Any installation must name protected/target disks and recovery.
expected_evidence: Pre/post device inventory and exact CD-ROM identity

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source mixes a local example NFS mount, BMC virtual media and optional OS installation; Criteria omit numbered requirements and demand an auto-install program without defining target or expected state.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Reversible mount and destructive installation have incompatible safety/acceptance contracts. The owner must choose and specify one before any action.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects generic PARTIAL because it cannot resolve end state or disk safety.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on BLOCKED and sharpens NFS export/security and cleanup requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: The block is semantic and safety-critical, not caused by ordinary missing project parameters or WebUI attendance.

review_improvement: Separates export reachability, virtual-media exposure and installation into independently provable scopes.
independent_technical_reasoning: An NFS device listing can prove media exposure, not remote-console behavior or an authorized installer. Because the source makes installer appearance part of acceptance without target-disk boundaries, execution would require guessing a destructive scope.
